cells.quote: In the empirical study, the estimated person parameter is positively associated with reward accumulation, task completion, and efficiency.
cells.note: The entry reports the Pearson and Spearman correlations; the study text frames this as a validity check rather than evidence that the estimated parameter represents a pure ability construct.

cells.quote: The corresponding mean estimates were 1.181, 1.506, and 2.343, respectively, and the overall group difference was highly significant under a Kruskal–Wallis test (p= 8.62×10 −29).
cells.note: The provided study text does not include the Figure 10 group-label sentence; this quote is copied from the wiki entry. The reported means are ordered across incomplete, task-complete-only, and job-complete episodes.
